$comment: Design sets the span is measured on (ADR-0043, TECH_DEBT §18). Ground truth read off the drawings by hand. `pages` are the sheets of the design itself, as a segmenter would cut them: the licence bound into a customer's set is a document of its own. `spanOverallDimensions` is the overall dimension of each chain, which the spacings of that chain are added up against (COMM-160). `spanDimensions` null is the answer for a set whose plans mark no axes — the three customer designs dimension rooms, and a span read off one of them is a room read as a span.
